title: Blue Demon and Bell
description: A muscular blue demon with large curved horns and glowing red eyes stands in a gothic cathedral, holding a large golden bell chained to a blonde woman in a blue corset dress seated in turbulent waters. In the background, a woman in a green dress ascends a staircase while the night sky swirls with colorful nebulae, stars, and red constellation lines.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal fantasy scene inside a gothic cathedral with swirling cosmic night sky filled with stars and red constellation patterns. A massive muscular blue demon with curved horns and glowing eyes stands powerfully holding a large golden bell attached by heavy chains to a beautiful blonde woman wearing a tight blue corset dress and black choker, seated in churning blue waves with floating books. In the background a woman in a flowing green dress climbs a stone staircase. Dramatic lighting, intricate details, vibrant colors.
